title: Identifying Perfect-Complier Effects in Three-Factor Offer Designs with Interactive Compliance
banked_reason: Not salvageable within scope — bank downgraded, or re-anchor the proposal.
gap_reasons: The note proves the advertised 29-map classification, signed identification formulas, and both directions of maximality within the explicitly stated one-sided three-factor WARP ambient class; no open conjecture remains in that headline.

Its contribution is nevertheless confined to three factors, requires retention of the eight-map separable baseline, and provides no applied reanalysis or software evidence showing that the 21 added types materially change an empirical conclusion.
The Fieller coverage proof uses positive variance only at u=mu_t^star; requiring it for every real u is materially stronger.
The attested quotation does not establish the lemma's claimed joint cell influence representation, exact primitive hypotheses, Fieller studentization, or seven-dimensional Wald conclusion.
Not salvageable within scope — bank downgraded, or re-anchor the proposal (rewind D-1.2).
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery completed the symbolic 28-null-map classification, the exact 29-map envelope, signed identification formulas, and the all-excluded-type converse. The mathematics remained sound, but the independent referee capped the fixed three-factor one-sided result at incremental novelty; field status would require a broader-factor/model frontier or a substantive application/software result. The archived inference rung also retains nonminimal-assumption and source-match caveats and was never formalized in Lean.
tldr: A randomized three-factor offer design can tolerate economically meaningful interactive compliance without restricting outcome heterogeneity. Within the present one-sided WARP ambient class, the result characterizes the unique largest response support containing every coordinate-separable map for which all eight perfect-complier potential-outcome means remain identified. The eight-map baseline is the one-sided three-factor specialization, and hence only a subclass, of Blackwell--Pashley's coordinate-specific receipt model. The envelope is the union of the perfect-complier map and the WARP maps with zero Boolean Möbius signatures; a symbolic choice argument shows that it contains exactly 29 maps, including 21 interactive maps and six maps for which every offer coordinate matters. Signed assignment-cell transforms identify the eight means, Walsh transforms identify all seven factorial effects, and an explicit Bernoulli null-space construction proves failure on every present-ambient support containing an excluded rational type. Joint influence functions yield simultaneous Wald inference away from a zero perfect-complier share, while Bonferroni--Fieller inversion remains honest about weak denominators.
gap: Goff's finite-support criterion characterizes outcome-nonrestrictive identification abstractly and gives a two-factor WARP application, while Blackwell and Pashley identify arbitrary-factor perfect-complier effects by imposing coordinate-specific receipt. Neither accessible result supplies a symbolic three-factor WARP envelope that is simultaneously sufficient and maximal for the entire vector of perfect-complier means.
fill: The project derives the Möbius coefficients from the separable baseline, classifies every WARP map annihilated by those coefficients, proves the identifying formulas, and constructs observationally equivalent Bernoulli laws for every forbidden enlargement. The inference rung propagates the common signed denominator through all eight means and seven Walsh contrasts without claiming uniform adaptation as the denominator vanishes.
